recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular composition of three smiling performers—two men with dark hair and beards flanking a central blonde woman—set against a textured, medium-blue studio backdrop. The lighting is soft and directional, creating a warm, nostalgic film grain aesthetic typical of mid-1960s commercial photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular head arrangement with the central figure lower than the flanking figures
High-contrast relationship between dark suits and the vibrant blue background
Vertical stack of centered script typography in the upper-middle negative space
Horizontal technical header bar at the very top edge
coreInvariants: Warm skin tones against a cool blue field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tight bust-up crop, occupying the lower two-thirds and right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blonde woman's face, positioned at the bottom-center of the trio's formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right male face, moves down to the central female face, then up to the left male face, finally resting on the central text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space in the upper left and top center to accommodate branding and titles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium cornflower blue background providing a cool, stable field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns of the suits and hair for structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold/yellow used for the secondary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin/hair and dark clothing; moderate saturation in the blue background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a heavy, swash-heavy Victorian-style script with ball terminals
Secondary title uses a condensed, high-contrast transitional serif
Technical header uses a wide, geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and loops on capital letters in the script
Tight kerning to create a vertical block effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for personality paired with a structured serif for legibility and a geometric sans for technical metadata.
graphicDevices: Horizontal double-ended arrow bar for technical labeling
Small circular or shield-shaped logo in upper left

preserve: Gold and white color contrast in text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s decorative flair and weight
Matches the high-contrast serif subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy 1960s color photograph of three smiling people (two men with beards, one blonde woman) in dark suits against a solid blue studio wall. The composition is a tight triangular crop. Leave the upper center and upper left areas clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of white decorative script text in the upper center-right. Below it, add a golden-yellow serif subtitle. At the very top, place a thin black horizontal line with arrows at both ends and a small geometric sans-serif word in the middle.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and authentic to the 1960s?
Is the text centered vertically in the negative space?
Do the subjects appear to be genuinely laughing/smiling?
Is the blue background a flat, slightly textured studio wall?

mustRedesign: Original artist names and album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap faces
Verify the presence of the top technical arrow bar
Confirm the grainy, matte texture of the print
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 1960s folk-trio portrait + cornflower blue studio background + vertically stacked Victorian script + technical header bar = Retro Folk Album Aesthetic.
